title: UAAP: FEU-Diliman boys repeat over La Salle-Zobel for third straight win
summary: Far Eastern University-Diliman made it three wins in a row on Saturday, taking down De La Salle Zobel 82-76 in the UAAP Season 89 16-and-under boys' basketball tournament at the Araneta Coliseum.
